paper_description: Proposes RM-US[m/(3m-2)] algorithm extending uniprocessor RM for multiprocessor static-priority scheduling, guaranteeing schedulability up to m/3 utilization, and shows no static-priority algorithm can exceed m/2.

formal_description.statement: Predictability: Algorithm A is predictable for task system T if for every feasible schedule OPT of T, RM(A, T) is feasible.

variables.RM(A, T): schedule produced by A on T

formal_description.conclusion: Defines when an algorithm preserves feasibility across schedules

informal_sketch.intuition: Ensures that if any schedule works, this algorithm's does too.
steps: Check if OPT meets all deadlines

formal_description.statement: Light system on m processors: U(T) <= m/2 and no task has U_i > 1/2.
formal_description.conclusion: Classifies low-density task sets for simpler analysis

informal_sketch.intuition: Systems light enough to schedule without overload risks.
informal_sketch.pseudocode:
def is_light_system(T, m):
    U_total = sum(task.U for task in T)
    max_U = max(task.U for task in T)
    return U_total <= m / 2 and max_U <= 0.5

formal_description.statement: For any jobs I, time t > 0, work-conserving algorithm A: total execution by A in [0,t] >= total by OPT in [0,t] - (m-1)t.
formal_description.conclusion: Bounds idle time in work-conserving schedules

informal_sketch.intuition: Work-conserving can't lag optimal by more than m-1 processors worth.
steps: Assume A idles while OPT works
Max lag from m-1 processors idling
informal_sketch.pseudocode:
def bound_execution(A, OPT, t, m):
    exec_A = total_exec(A, [0,t])
    exec_OPT = total_exec(OPT, [0,t])
    return exec_A >= exec_OPT - (m-1)*t
key_insights: Phillips et al. result for multiprocessor bounds

formal_description.statement: Any priority-driven scheduling algorithm is predictable.

informal_sketch.intuition: Fixed priorities don't introduce new misses if optimal exists.
steps: If OPT feasible, priority-driven matches order

formal_description.statement: For light system, RM schedules first k <= m tasks feasibly if hyperperiod <= (2m-1)/m * T_k.

informal_sketch.intuition: Top m tasks get full parallelism.
steps: Highest m tasks execute without interference

formal_description.statement: RM-US[m/(3m-2)] schedules any light system feasibly.

steps: US assigns m/(3m-2) capacity to each lower task

formal_description.statement: RM-US[m/(3m-2)] schedules any periodic task system with U <= m/3 on m processors.

informal_sketch.intuition: m/3 bound from light + heavy cases.

formal_description.statement: No static-priority multiprocessor algorithm guarantees > m/2 utilization.
